answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 10897 Country: India Title: Asalamoalaikum. I study medical n we sell bones for studying anatomy to our juniors. Now my question is dat, do i have to sell the bones at a lesser price dan wht i bought earlier as i have studied on these bones n i dont need them anymore, and they r second hand, or i can sell them at any price i want, or is it some fixd profit on goods u sell. Waiting 4 ur ans Question: Asalamoalaikum. I study medical n we sell bones for studying anatomy to our juniors. Now my question is dat, do i have to sell the bones at a lesser price dan wht i bought earlier as i have studied on these bones n i dont need them anymore, and they r second hand, or i can sell them at any price i want, or is it some fixd profit on goods u sell. Waiting 4 ur ans Answer ID: 10897 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 247/247=M/1430) If they are not human bones rather animal bones and you own them, then you can sell them. The ratio of profit is not fixed, you can sell them on the price you purchased or more than that. But, it is wrong to take advantage of one?s helplessness and take more than normal profit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
